ns2:section.sectionText: Creative Collaborations in the Performing Arts: This course is designed for students seeking a career in the performing arts in a variety of disciplines—performers, composers, designers, directors, and so on. It will be comprised of attending events at the Krannert Center for the Performing Arts in which the artists are collaborating to create new work. Classwork will include research about the artists and subject matter, interacting with the artists, and reflecting on the different paradigms available to artists in devising work.
